review_method: Source-order full read of all 1200 candidate IDs. The fixed English patch was used as the correction baseline and rationale for localization choices; Japanese was consulted to confirm source semantics and resolve ambiguity. Korean was judged for accuracy, naturalness, register, terminology, referents, and obvious text breakage. Final in-scope result: 43 EDIT and 1157 KEEP, no exclusions and no propagation. The reviewed manifest was applied through the existing Beta1 reviewed-copyedit queue, and the semantic commit passed exact-before application, zero-layout-drift checks, the existing Korean gates, and the English-consumer storage/effective-layout contract before review-basis registration. No historical-range cleanup is credited to this scope.
